EX_REFUSED_ABSOLUTE_PATH.condition: a parent URI, a shard URI, a shard file name or a manifest parent path is absolute
EX_REFUSED_ABSOLUTE_PATH.prevents: that a host path is read as a portable artefact reference, and that a shard file is taken from outside the export directory

EX_REFUSED_ARTIFACT_DROPPED.condition: a result names an artifact URI the shard's `artifacts` table omits or changed
EX_REFUSED_ARTIFACT_DROPPED.prevents: that a location is resolvable when its artifact entry is absent, and that an index still points at the artifact it claims

EX_REFUSED_CANDIDATE_UNRECORDED.condition: the parent, a shard or the manifest records no candidate, or a different one
EX_REFUSED_CANDIDATE_UNRECORDED.prevents: that a result is bound to the candidate it was emitted at when the identity is absent or has moved

EX_REFUSED_DIGEST_MISMATCH.condition: a shard's bytes do not hash to the digest the manifest records
EX_REFUSED_DIGEST_MISMATCH.prevents: that the analysed shard is the emitted shard, so evidence from one file is not reused for another

EX_REFUSED_MANIFEST_ABSENT.condition: no manifest was supplied or it cannot be read
EX_REFUSED_MANIFEST_ABSENT.prevents: that a set of shard files is an export: without the manifest there is no statement of the population and no union check

EX_REFUSED_MANIFEST_SHARD_MISSING.condition: the manifest and the shard set disagree about which shards exist
EX_REFUSED_MANIFEST_SHARD_MISSING.prevents: that the files on disk and the results the manifest accounts for are the same set

EX_REFUSED_NETWORK_OR_CREDENTIAL.condition: the export module imports a network client, reads a credential, or uploads
EX_REFUSED_NETWORK_OR_CREDENTIAL.prevents: that the export depends on a service, a token or a network call; the export is a local transformation and must remain one

EX_REFUSED_ORDER_CHANGED.condition: a shard's result order is not the parent order restricted to it
EX_REFUSED_ORDER_CHANGED.prevents: that a reordered shard is a faithful subset; order is the only positional check against the parent's own emission order

EX_REFUSED_OUTPUT_NOT_EMPTY.condition: the output directory is not empty and `--force` was not given
EX_REFUSED_OUTPUT_NOT_EMPTY.prevents: that an unrelated directory is overwritten in the belief that it is this export's output

EX_REFUSED_OVERSIZE_SHARD.condition: a shard holds more results than the export limit (5,000)
EX_REFUSED_OVERSIZE_SHARD.prevents: that a file the service would truncate is a complete shard, so an ingestion-side cut is read as a shard that held nothing more

EX_REFUSED_PARENT_SHAPE.condition: the parent is unreadable, malformed, or internally inconsistent
EX_REFUSED_PARENT_SHAPE.prevents: that a shape this tool does not understand is exported as if it were the A1 profile

EX_REFUSED_RULE_DROPPED.condition: a result names a rule the shard's `rules` table omits or changed
EX_REFUSED_RULE_DROPPED.prevents: that a self-contained log exists when its rule descriptions are absent, which leaves `ruleId` readable but its meaning unstated

EX_REFUSED_SHARD_AS_CENSUS.condition: a shard carries a completeness or census property
EX_REFUSED_SHARD_AS_CENSUS.prevents: that one shard is the population, which would make every other shard and the manifest look like duplicates or noise

EX_REFUSED_TOOL_DROPPED.condition: a shard run's tool identity is not the parent run's
EX_REFUSED_TOOL_DROPPED.prevents: that a result produced by a different producer is evidence from this parent

EX_REFUSED_UNION_DUPLICATE.condition: the union holds an exact identity more than once
EX_REFUSED_UNION_DUPLICATE.prevents: that a repeated result is two results, which would inflate the population and hide a missing one

EX_REFUSED_UNION_INCOMPLETE.condition: a parent result identity is missing from the union of the shards
EX_REFUSED_UNION_INCOMPLETE.prevents: that the shards together hold the parent population when a result was dropped or never emitted

EX_REFUSED_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.condition: the parent, a shard or the manifest is not the supported version
EX_REFUSED_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.prevents: that a different format is read with this export's rules; a 2.2 or a later manifest is not this manifest

controls.note: 5,001 results in one shard against the 5,000 limit
the manifest names two shards; one is supplied
the first result of shard 1 is present twice
a used rule removed from shard 0
a referenced artifact removed from shard 0
shard 0 carries a candidate that is not the parent's
one artifact URI is a host path
a run repeats a rule id
a source that imports a network client and reads a token

realModule: no network client, no credential read, no upload
